sources.review_notes: First-party cooperative native Codex goal protocol. Fresh native human-input consent; no predictions, prompt sender, daemon, API key, app patch or private IPC. Local state is evidence, not cryptographic authentication; native permissions remain authoritative.

Independently authored, agent-callable coverage workflow with bounded worker handoff and parent acceptance. The measure/add/verify/report loop was informed by ECC commands/test-coverage.md; no ECC runtime or Superpowers dependency. Provenance and behavioral evaluation criteria live in references/fault-checks.md.

Reviewed NoteBridge 1.0.1 source 88d826a: compact batched metadata and pagination; explicit raw_content, rich views and image references; validated creation/diff/hash previews, append/replace/move/delete, stale-write refusal and read-back. Preserve spacing, blank lines, list markers and link destinations. Whole-document replacements disclose formatting loss. Attachment and native list/table body edits fail closed; checklist completion and native history are unavailable; new HTML image import is refused; native writes have no atomic CAS.
Native Urgent is unsupported. Use a timed alarm when timing matters and leave priority unset unless the user explicitly requests a supported priority.
Upstream README and commands/auth.mdx reviewed for install and credential names on 2026-09-09. No binary version pinned, installed, or audited; brew install asc requires deliberate installation.
